posts.title: A modern port of Linux to a ten-year-old QWERTY phone.
posts.description: Link to the branch A note to the reader This post is fully composed by me, a human, fatto a mano . The port is accomplished with the help of Claude. It would have taken six months or longer to accomplish this port to the point I was able to reach without that tool. I have no plans on submitting this code in this form to upstream but designed it with that eventual goal. I would review and clean up
